integrity: The upper bound is derived from the exact l_p operator norm of the K4 difference operator, interpolation between exact p=2 and p=infinity endpoints, and the six-number power-mean inequality. A centered tetrahedral configuration attains equality for every finite p>=2, and the p=infinity endpoint is direct. The bundled numerical checker is supplementary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers real ell_p spaces for 2<=p<=infinity when at least three coordinates are available. It does not determine the higher-dimensional 1<p<2 regime and does not classify all extremizing quadruples.
title: Exact inscribed-quadrilateral constant of real ℓp above the Hilbert exponent
